key_concepts: Comets are icy bodies with highly elliptical orbits around the Sun
A comet has three parts: nucleus, coma, and tail
Comet tails grow longer near the Sun and always point away from the Sun
Short-period comets come from the Kuiper Belt; long-period comets come from the Oort Cloud
Halley's Comet is a short-period comet with a 76-year orbit
Asteroids are rocky or metallic objects, mostly orbiting between Mars and Jupiter
Ceres is the largest asteroid and asteroids are also called minor planets
Meteoroids are space rock fragments; meteors are streaks of light in the atmosphere; meteo
Meteor showers occur when Earth passes through debris left by a comet
Impact craters are bowl-shaped depressions formed when meteorites hit a planet or moon
Crater size and shape depend on the impactor's size and speed
Earth's atmosphere, weather, and life can erode or hide impact craters
